I'm sorry, but a price difference isn't available in this case. Our price drop policy gives you the difference as store credit if the price falls within 7 days of purchase. Your order is 5 days old, so it's within that window, but flash sales are specifically excluded, so the flash sale price doesn't qualify.

If the price drops again outside of a flash sale or clearance while you're still within 7 days of purchase (about 2 more days), the difference can be issued as store credit, once per item.

If you'd like, I can pass this to a Support Lead to review. Is there anything else I can help with?
